svg.title: How We Moved Prisma's Control Plane to Prisma Postgres Without Downtime
svg.desc: A contribution-style grid of 83 small rounded squares split into two groups: a grey RDS group on the left with one square outlined instead of filled, a thin arrow carrying three squares across the gap, and a cyan Prisma Postgres group on the right. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism cyan accent.
